reviews.text: Sophia was amazing! She genuinely wants you to look your best and really cares about helping you achieve the look you want. I originally went in for lip filler, but she gave me such great recommendations on other treatments that could help me achieve my desired look without necessarily needing fillers. We ended up going with 0.7 ml of lip filler, and my inspo was Jang Wonyoung. I went home extremely satisfied with my results! She really listened to what I wanted and helped me achieve a look that I absolutely love. I definitely recommend her! 💗

Absolutely AMAZING! 10 Years Younger! 💖

Oligio X was a total game-changer, and the shoulder Botox was just as amazing!

But what truly blew me away was the doctor’s incredible skill and attention to detail. Every treatment was so carefully customized to my unique facial features, and the results look incredibly natural!

The best part? People around me keep telling me I look 10 years younger! I honestly couldn’t be happier!

I truly don’t think there’s another med spa quite like this in Dallas. The experience, the artistry, and the personalized care are on another level.

SUA GLOW is like your favorite dessert shop — once you visit, you just can’t stop thinking about going back! 🥰

I’m already looking forward to my next visit. Absolutely obsessed with SUA GLOW! 💕
Great experience!! Sophia was so communicative with me and what I wanted and executed it perfectly!! She also checked in with me after and was very nice and am loving my results of filler!!!
Amazing results that my gf got! Would recommend. Everything has a personal touch so you that you can have the perfect result you want

Today, I experienced the same excellent care I received in Korea.

All the staff were kind, and I am very satisfied with having clean and moisturized skin after the treatment.

I definitely want to visit again.

First time ever for botox. Sophia gave such a great consultation for the first timer and understood exactly what my needs were. Got skintox + botox in jawline and between eyebrows. Much more tolerable pain than I expected. I'm excited to see how it'll turn out in a few days. I'd recommend this place 10/10

I’d make it a little warmer and more specific while keeping it natural:

Sophia is the absolute best! She is incredibly knowledgeable, attentive, and genuinely cares about helping you achieve the results you’re looking for. She takes the time to listen, explain everything clearly, and makes you feel completely comfortable and confident in your treatment plan. I always feel like I’m in excellent hands with her. Highly recommend!

I had such a great experience with Sophia for my skin consultation! She was very knowledgeable and took the time to thoroughly explain the different procedures that would work best for my skin and address the areas I’m interested in. She answered all of my questions and made me feel very comfortable and informed about my options. I really appreciated how thorough and helpful she was. Highly recommend Sophia!

I recently received a high-concentration skin booster treatment, and I truly had such a wonderful experience. From the moment I arrived,  Dr. Sophia was warm, professional, and made me feel very comfortable. They carefully explained the procedure and answered all of my questions, which made me feel confident and relaxed throughout the treatment.
After the treatment, my skin looked noticeably more hydrated, radiant, and smooth. The glow was natural and healthy-looking, and my skin texture felt softer and refreshed. I especially loved how my skin looked brighter and more even without needing much makeup.
I’m very happy with my results and really appreciate the care and attention I received here. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for healthy, glowing skin and a professional skincare experience.
I’m also excited to try the new Oligio X treatment next time!

Had an amazing experience at SuA Glow. I was a bit nervous about getting Botox on my jaw and frown lines, but the consultation was so thorough that I felt instantly at ease.

The clinic itself is beautiful, clean, and the staff are professional. The procedure was quick, painless, and the results are so natural. Highly recommend if you want that perfect K-beauty glow!
